lines: Hidden like a star, the focus never aligns.
The angel is no longer in this room.
These days I meet the eyes of strangers I don't even know.
A gear starts turning, guided by something.
A sound that splits my ears.
When dawn comes, I beg for what I don't have.
When someone's sleep‑talk drifts through the streets.
Ah, what a masterpiece.
HELP!! If it stays like this, I can't live.
Daddy, mummy, I can't keep being a good girl!
So.
HELP!! My bravado goes too far.
Even my selfish days aren't bad.
HELP!!
Because the number of stray bullets keeps rising.
A occasional luck won't be enough in time.
These days I meet the eyes of people whose names I don't even know.
A gear begins to go awry, guided by something.
Dreaming time is limited.
The more I expected, the more the discord betrays me.
Where is the reason that I must be me?
Ah, what a failure.
HELP!! I want to walk down the main street.
Daddy, mummy, I can't end things as just a good girl!
So.
HELP!! Cowardice also gets a hold of me.
It's just selfish kindness, nothing more.
HELP!!
Please go away!!
Insults and curses, but above the universe.
Always on the brink of explosion, that's enough.
I want to dream, but
Mimpi terasa jauh, ku terkurung
Like a powerless machine, empty and lifeless
Because I have no choice
HELP!! If it stays like this, it's not fun.
Daddy, mummy, I want to let the tips of my hair run wild too!
See.
HELP!! It's a hassle, so everything is perfectly right.
I can have anything I want, and I will make it happen.
HELP!! If it stays like this, I can't live.
Daddy, mummy, I can't keep being a good girl!
So.
HELP!! I just want to stare at the present moment.
Yes, I won't let the present slip away.
HELP!!
HELP!!
HELP!!
